name: Progress M-6
about: Progress M-6 (1991-002A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1991 Jan 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1991 Feb 14), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
